mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressures that typically lead to tighter monetary policy, which in turn increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the inflation signal, or if the Rank IC of CPIAUCSL with 20-day forward returns is below 0.1 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates weakening consumer demand, which leads to reduced corporate revenues and earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the demand signal, or if the Rank IC of RSAFS with 20-day forward returns is below 0.1 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past month signals labor market weakness, which typically precedes an economic downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the labor market signal, or if the Rank IC of UNRATE with 5-day forward returns is below 0.15 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the past 3 months indicates supply-side constraints and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the supply-side signal, or if the Rank IC of INDPRO with 60-day forward returns is below 0.1 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the combined signal, or if the Rank IC of the interaction term with 20-day forward returns is below 0.1 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to wage inflation and increased costs for businesses, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the labor market signal, or if the Rank IC of the interaction term with 60-day forward returns is below 0.1 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months signals increased demand for housing and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive demand signal, or if the Rank IC of HOUST with 20-day forward returns is below 0.1 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle, a decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% over the past month signals accommodative monetary policy, which typically boosts equity markets, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the easing signal, or if the Rank IC of FEDFUNDS with 5-day forward returns is below 0.15 over a 2-year rolling window.
